stem: The heights, in centimetres, of adult females in Litania have mean $\mu$ and standard deviation $\sigma$. It is known that in 2004 the values of $\mu$ and $\sigma$ were 163.21 and 6.95 respectively. The government claims that the value of $\mu$ this year is greater than it was in 2004. In order to test this claim a researcher plans to carry out a hypothesis test at the 1% significance level. He records the heights of a random sample of 300 adult females in Litania this year and finds the value of the sample mean.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State the probability of a Type I error.

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem: You should assume that the value of $\sigma$ after 2004 remains at 6.95.
parts.text: Given that the value of $\mu$ this year is actually 164.91, find the probability of a Type II error.
